# Asmaa Salem (أسماء سالم)

> Asmaa Mohammed Salem is a specialised life coach who works with the Lüscher Color Test and Meta-Health. She helps clients understand their emotions, the roots of their stress, and the emotional causes behind physical symptoms. The site is bilingual: Arabic (the main language) and English.

She came to coaching from project management: she used to manage projects in the outer world, and now helps people understand the thoughts and emotions of their inner world.

## Services

- Emotional analysis through the Lüscher Color Diagnostic Test: a focused session on deeper emotions, sources of stress and imbalance, daily challenges and psychological needs.
- Lüscher Test and emotional root causes of illness (Meta-Health): sessions that look for the emotional roots of illness, using the Lüscher Color Diagnostic Test.
- Lüscher Support Platform: a tool that helps certified Lüscher students and practitioners analyse Lüscher Color Test results.

## Credentials

- Max Lüscher Foundation: certified to use the Lüscher diagnostic test (Max Lüscher Institute, Switzerland)
- Master's degree in Holistic Healing by Color Therapy (Arab Academy of Behavioral Science)
- MTN Master (Manage the Now Academy)
- Life Coach, beginner to advanced (Academy of Modern Applied Psychology)
- Diploma in Mental Health and Wellness (Academy of Modern Applied Psychology)
